//: Composite indexes for Action ou Verite Live. Single-field equality/range/orderBy queries (e.g. friendRequests by toUid alone, rooms by inviteCode, signals by to/from, users orderBy displayName) are served by Firestore's automatic single-field indexes and are intentionally not listed here. Only multi-field combinations and explicit ordering needs that Firestore cannot auto-serve are declared below.

indexes.//: Global/national leaderboard: users ordered by stats.xp desc (LeaderboardRepositoryImpl.baseQuery). Declared explicitly so national scope can extend it with countryCode.
National leaderboard: filter by countryCode then order by stats.xp desc.
Incoming friend requests, newest first (FriendRepositoryImpl.observeIncomingRequests: whereEqualTo toUid, ordered by recency).
Outgoing friend requests, newest first (sender views their pending invites).
Matchmaking pool: candidate selection filtered by language then ordered by recency (server-side matcher reads the queue; MatchmakingRepositoryImpl publishes languageCode/level/enqueuedAt).
Matchmaking pool refined by language + country + recency for stricter same-region matching.
